instructions: Read the primary source in full. Produce a repository-quality structured research record covering problem, novelty, method, evaluation conditions, key quantitative results, limitations, implementation status, and relation to existing repository lineages. Preserve publication date/status, implementation and source URLs; for an arXiv paper, record its primary and cross-list categories from arXiv. Do not infer missing text from abstracts/search snippets. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. selection_reason: multi-state linear attentionでsegmentごとのkey-query平均alignmentだけを使うroutingでは分布の広がりを捉えられない。MERLINは各segment keyの一次・二次momentを保持し、queryごとのalignment平均と分散から各stateのreadoutを重み付けする。Gated DeltaNet-1.3BとMamba-2-780MのRULER/LongBenchで改善し、4倍メモリを使うbaselineも上回ると要旨は報告。推論時の圧縮state routingで長文脈品質とメモリのtradeoffを改善する直接手法としてaccept。
title: Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
